verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a user-configurable automation feature that runs autonomously in the background. The closest items are adjacent: webhooks and the Subscriptions and Invoices APIs are developer building blocks, fraud custom rules and alerts are a narrow risk control, and the MCP server is driven by the client on request rather than running in the background. None of these is Square's own general automation capability for this story, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
